title: Bob Parsons, GoDaddy - Luck and Perspective (full keynote speech)
description: Success is part passion, part perspective, part luck and a whole lot of effort. If you are able to accept the worst that can possibly happen, take things one day at a time, you can get through anything.   In this presentation, Bob Parsons, Founder and Chairman of GoDaddy, shares his story about the bumps, battles and "buxom breasts" which shaped his entrepreneurial success.  Credit Suisse hosted its fifth annual Entrepreneurs Summit at the Sundance Resort in Utah, returning to a place famed for its rocky peaks, snow-covered forests and emphasis on creativity and innovation. In line with the theme "Turning Ideas into Action," a select group of 60 entrepreneurs and innovators engaged in wide-ranging discussions on strategies and best practices that allow entrepreneurs to transform and revolutionize industries.
